court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sushama Mukesh Pawar vs Mukesh Sharad Pawar
facts_of_case: The applicant wife has filed proceedings under Section 125 of Code of Criminal Procedure at Ahmednagar. She is staying with her parents and has no source of income. The respondent husband has lodged proceedings in the Family Court at Pune seeking restitution of conjugal rights.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to establish that she is unable to maintain herself and her child.
legal_principles.held: After having driven out from the matrimonial house, the applicant is staying with her parents at Ahmednagar and there is no source of income for livelihood, which constrained her to file proceedings under Section 125 of Code of Criminal Procedure at Ahmednagar.

legal_principles.principle: A spouse seeking restitution of conjugal rights must establish that the other spouse is not living separately and not consenting to live together.
legal_principles.held: The respondent - husband has lodged proceedings in the Family Court at Pune bearing Hindu Marriage Petition No. 368 of 2015, under Section 9 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 seeking restitution of conjugal rights.

outcome.final_order: The applicant's request to transfer the proceedings filed by the respondent at Pune to Ahmednagar is allowed.

use_for_drafting: responding to notice of proceedings under Section 125
